id: RTC-周期闹钟-内部低频晶振
title: RTC 周期闹钟（内部低频晶振）
description: The following example configures the RTC in periodic mode with a default interval of 1Hz (1s). The LED and USER_TEST pin are toggled at every interval. RTCCLK is sourced from the internal low frequency oscillator (LFOSC). The device remains in STANDBY mode while waiting for an interrupt.（SDK 例程：rtc_periodic_alarm_lfosc_standby）
